remarks: Move in ready and just in time to jump in the pool, only steps away! This comfortable 2 Bedroom, 1.5 Bathroom Townhome is located in highly desirable Winnipauk Village. Main level offers Kitchen open to Dining Room, 1/2 bath and Living Room combo with hardwood floors. Sliders open out to a private deck overlooking mature trees. Upper level has two Bedrooms with carpet and generous closets and full size bathroom with tub and double sinks. Stackable full size washer/dryer is included. Winnipauk Village is well maintained & nestled upon 16 acres of a park-like setting in wooded surroundings. Enjoy all the amenities it has to offer: clubhouse, visitor parking, 2 pools & fitness center with racquetball courts! Easy commute conveniently located to Metro North train station, Merrit Pkwy & I-95. Very close to shopping, restaurants, beach, museums, parks & more! $400 move-in charge. Sold AS IS.
